content.text:
The site looks right again. All 12 visual tests and all 16 functional tests now pass.

The cause was in `site/css/tokens.css`. The `@font-face` rule for Acme Sans declared only `font-weight: 400`. The font file is evidently a variable font, though I couldn't confirm that directly. With only weight 400 declared, the browser faked the 600, 700 and 800 weights for headings, buttons and nav. That made the text look different on every page.

I changed the declaration to `font-weight: 100 900;`, so the browser uses the real weights from the font file. Nothing else was touched. The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced this and diagnosed it from the screenshot diffs instead.

The `.idea` and `.vscode` folders in `git status` were already untracked, and I didn't create them. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
